summary: Quassel IRC is a distributed Internet Relay Chat client where a central core daemon maintains persistent server connections. Multiple user interfaces can attach to or detach from this core at any time without losing chat session state.
goodFor: It suits users who want to maintain a permanent, always-online IRC presence from multiple different devices.
watchOut: The codebase has a low maintenance activity level and infrequent releases, meaning bug fixes and modern updates may be slow to arrive.
deployNotes: As a compiled C++ application, the core typically requires persistent storage for configuration and state, and you will usually want to place a reverse proxy in front of it to handle TLS termination.
